text: Useful artificial intelligence begins with responsible human review.
Read the practice draft on screen.
It claims an award-winning team and guarantees a perfect result.
Neither claim is supported by our fictional case.
A confident tone is not evidence.
Remove the invented award and the guarantees, then return to an open question and a clear next step.
Explain one correction in your own words.
This is a supplied example, so you do not need an AI account and you should not enter client information.
Finally, choose one action you can complete within thirty days.
Add a date and plan checks on days seven, fourteen and thirty.
You remain responsible for what you use.
